      "name": "kernel",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes libbitcoinkernel public C API in bitcoinkernel.h and bitcoinkernel.cpp, introducing btck_BlockManager to decouple block storage from ChainstateManager.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "unblocks #35627",
      "rationale": "Enables kernel callers to independently configure and manage block storage, directly unblocking kernel support for pruned block directories (#35627). This directly advances API completeness and decoupling for external library consumers."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Does not touch mempool or policy logic; path hint was triggered by incidental edits in src/validation.cpp.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "This PR does not alter mempool data structures, eviction, or policy rules."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits to test files (src/test/kernel/test_kernel.cpp and setup_common.cpp) follow directly from the kernel API changes rather than altering test framework infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Test updates are kernel unit tests pinning the new API rather than reusable test harness machinery."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to src/bitcoin-chainstate.cpp are mechanical call-site adjustments to the updated kernel API.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not modify standalone developer tooling or scripts."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Modifications in src/init.cpp merely pass through block manager initialization to the kernel/node callers.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not alter core shared utilities, logging, or cryptographic primitives."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Explicitly excluded by validation's scope rules, which state that PRs whose primary subject is the kernel library API belong in kernel even when touching validation files.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Although labeled Validation, the PR makes structural refactors to decouple block manager construction without modifying validation or consensus logic."
    }
  ],
